data.body: FINAL_REMEDIATION: Define audit step names as shared Makefile constants. In Makefile.audit: DD4_STEP := dd4-phase-gate, DD1_STEP := dd1-baseline, DD2_STEP := dd2-orphan-count, DD3_STEP := dd3-mutation-caps, DD5_STEP := dd5-bundle. The audit-phase target uses $(DD4_STEP) $(DD1_STEP) $(DD2_STEP) $(DD3_STEP) $(DD5_STEP) in prerequisites. make -n smoke test asserts the printed plan contains the constants resolved in dependency order. Reduces rename-induced drift: a script rename only requires updating ONE constant, not every place the name appears.
